Chicken Melt Sandwich
By: Soni Khadilkar
Published: Wednesday, September 22, 2010 - 1:45pm

Ingredients




Ingredients
1 bowl full of chicken kheema (mashed)
1 tablespoon cabbage (shredded)
2 slices of cheese
mayonnaise/ cheese spread
lettuce leaves
3 slices of tomato
Pepper and salt for taste
2 slices of sandwich bread
Method
Mix chicken kheema, shredded cabage, mayonnaise/ cheese spread add salt and pepper
spread the above mixture on a slice of bread
add lettuce leaves& tomato
If you like sprinkle more pepper
Grill the bread into a griller
the sandwich
Serve with mashed patoto/ french fries/ chunky chips

Preparation
